svg.title: Failed finite polar transition: one repeated module, signed loads and stock ledger
svg.desc: Dimensioned D80 capsule and local polar module. Four pin intersections, AD insert overlap, short posts and root adapter gap remain. Nominal force routes leave unsupported moments and negative mass margins.

g.text: R3-I020 | corrected I016 comparison | 37 sectors × 2 caps | geometry unchanged after the failed trial
A Capsule and retained cap structure
Equal X/R scale. Both polar modules shown; all other failed hull structure carries.
Red: 72° → finite button. No whole-cap repair, volume credit or new gas charge.
B One meridional module: actual nodes and pins
Equal X/R scale; plate roots and fine hoops indicated. Both endpoints priced separately.
AD / BD / DC / BC pin lengths:
Pin centres: 300 mm from each node
Carbon setback: 250 mm from each pin
Red supports: selected cut does not fit.
Rows 1/17 cuffs also reach beyond carbon.
Scope: X=77…80 m near the pole; the existing 72° receiving frame remains fixed.
Tangential/radial projection at equal scale; axial stems shown separately in panel B.
PASS only for this named overlap.
D Separate centred ends: selected solids collide
Local details, mm. Fork cross-section schematic; pin disks and AD insert cuts dimensioned.
80 mm eye centred between two 30 mm forks
400 × 20 end plate; separate root and insert per end
No shorter insert or moved node is substituted.
D: all three 100 mm pin disks
Also D: AD/BD and BD/DC collide.
592 member-end assemblies + 592 distinct roots. A shared fitting is not silently substituted.
E Film normal stack and discontinuities
Nominal local normal coordinates, mm. Schematic support arrangement; dimensions govern.
R40 outer film face; 1 mm polymer (unqualified)
These new nominal gaps pass only their stated checks.
Hoop → DC post: min −30.258 mm vs required 80 mm.
Root datum: 53.356 mm normal step − 16 mm flat plate = 37.356 mm unbridged.
Root known step couple −84.205 Nm/clip; transfer remains conditional on the missing geometry.
F Conditional force routes, complete stock and retained limits
Two scalar radial-load assignments only. Equilibrium arithmetic is not a pressure or assembly qualification.
f=0: radial hoop compression, axial transfer.
f=1: all radial + axial transfer to posts/module.
BC Euler 9.461814 MN: FAIL in both limits.
DC actual axial force is tensile; no false compression.
Known A/B, D/C moments need an actual bending path.
Film trial 68.639 > 50 MPa; button strip also FAIL.
Reused finite button 5.334397 t is already in old hull.
Old removed-duty stock retained as inactive contingency.
All old remaining FAIL / physical and U+C UNKNOWN.
Next local construction: separate tangential pin planes + dedicated short AD cartridge + priced moment collector.
Scalar/vector arithmetic only · matrix order 0 · one geometry · no ancestor run or parameter sweep · see README and result.json for all parts and limits
